Iron Jugulis

Dark Flying

Paldea · Generation 9

Iron Jugulis is a Dark/Flying-type Paradox Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1.3 m tall and weighs 111 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (122), with a base stat total of 570.
